## Summary
- Adds a `SiteFooter` component (`components/site-footer.tsx`) rendered below page content in `app/layout.tsx`, appearing on every page.
- Footer contains two links — "Submit an idea" → `/submit` and "Contact" → `/contact` — plus the text "AI Garage · Solvd".
- Styled with new `.site-footer*` classes in `app/globals.css`, reusing the existing design-system variables (`--ink`, `--rule`, `--paper`, `--accent`) — no raw colors introduced.
- Follows the existing `components/portal-nav.tsx` pattern (Next.js `Link`, semantic `<nav>` with `aria-label`).

Card: https://trello.com/c/6a97b17badb9b190f777703b

## Test plan
- [x] `npm run lint` — passes on changed files
- [x] `npm run typecheck` — no errors
- [x] `npm test` — 79 tests passing
- [x] `npm run build` — production build succeeds
